title: Weather and building inputs for the nine-climate office comparison

scope.simulation_change: All comparisons use the same thermostat interface and release the three maximum-outdoor-air EMS overrides. The reference model preserves the prototype geometry, envelope, internal loads, nominal outdoor-air requirements and HVAC topology.

weather_metadata.header_interpretation: City, source, station identifier, latitude, longitude, time zone and elevation were read from each EPW LOCATION record according to the EnergyPlus EPW data dictionary.
weather_metadata.climate_zone_reference: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 169-2020 addendum a, station tables A-3, A-5 and A-6

download_verification.malmo: The local PVGIS 5.2 ERA5 EPW header and filename identify the 2005-2020 acquisition, and its fixed local SHA256 is recorded. The API output is dynamically served, so reproducibility is anchored to the recorded input hash.
download_verification.raw_file_policy: Simulation_Inputs.zip contains the Malmö weather file and lists provider URLs and checksums for the other eight weather files.

Malmo.basis: MALMO WMO 026350 and MALMO AP WMO 026360 are both 5A in Standard 169.

Tunis.basis: TUNIS CARTHAGE WMO 607150 is 2A in Standard 169.

Sydney.basis: SYDNEY AP WMO 947670 is 3A in Standard 169.

prototype.official_archive_rights_note: The source manifest identifies the DOE download and the hashes of the archive and its model files.
prototype.floor_area_evidence: An EnergyPlus 22.1 eplusout.eio generated from the fixed reference reports 18 zones. The 15 zones marked Part of Total Building Area=Yes sum to 4982.19 m2; three plenum zones are excluded.
prototype.official_description: The DOE/PNNL scorecard describes the medium office as 53,628 ft2 with packaged variable-air-volume HVAC and electric terminal reheat.

thermostat_deadband_evidence.basis: The experiment preserves the 3.0 C occupied heating-to-cooling separation in the official Medium Office IDF while translating its midpoint to each tested control target.
thermostat_deadband_evidence.interpretation: The deadband separates the occupied heating and cooling setpoints.

comparison_with_official_idf.declared_difference: The simulation model adds 30 zone-level setpoint schedules and actuators, meter and variable requests, SQLite reporting and the occupied thermostat schedules used by the control interface.

ventilation_control_adaptation.change: Three DOE maximum-outdoor-air EMS override actuators were released with NULL in every climate and controller while the native DesignSpecification:OutdoorAir objects and nominal ventilation requirements were retained.
ventilation_control_adaptation.basis: The common adaptation is documented and checked by src/utilities/audit_ventilation_adaptation.py against the declared ventilation-delivery and hourly outdoor-air/supply-flow gates.
ventilation_control_adaptation.interpretation: Every thermal-demand strategy uses the same ventilation controls.

prototype.model_manifest: matrix/models/MODEL_MANIFEST.json within the simulation output directory

source_identifiers.S06: DOE/PNNL ASHRAE 90.1-2019 Medium Office prototype archive
